name: Assurant
desc:
Remote Licensed P&C Insurance Specialist | $17.34 - $27.75/hr | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Assurant Renters Solutions
Industry: Insurance
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be on the phone all day helping renters and policyholders with real insurance issues, things like billing questions, policy changes, endorsements, and claims. You're not reading from a script, you're actually problem solving, issuing documents, fixing premium discrepancies, and jumping between multiple systems while keeping the conversation smooth and professional. It's a high volume, fast paced call environment, but one where your insurance knowledge actually gets used, not just your ability to follow a flowchart.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not specified in the posting
Required Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in a customer service or call center role within the insurance industry, plus an active P&C Producer/General or Personal Lines insurance license
Preferred Experience: Not specified beyond required qualifications
Required Skills:
Ability to manage high call volumes while maintaining quality and professionalism
Strong multitasking skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision
High proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams)
Excellent verbal and written communication
Ability to learn and navigate new systems quickly
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A participant who already holds an active P&C insurance license and has real call center or customer service experience in insurance
Someone who thrives in a high volume, fast paced phone environment
Someone who enjoys actual problem solving over reading from a script
Someone comfortable being on camera for interviews and completing identity verification steps
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone without an active P&C Producer or Personal Lines license, this is a hard requirement
Anyone without at least 2 years of insurance industry customer service or call center experience
Anyone uncomfortable with video interviews or biometric identity verification
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
P&C insurance license
Insurance call center
Policy servicing
Claims support
Billing and endorsements
High volume calls
Multitasking
Microsoft Office
Customer service
Insurance industry experience
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview (conducted on video, per company policy)
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average. Note the projected start date on this posting is October 2026.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience holding a P&C license and working in an insurance call center environment.
Walk us through how you'd handle a customer disputing a premium discrepancy.
How do you manage a high volume of calls while keeping quality and accuracy consistent?
Describe a time you had to learn a new system quickly while still meeting service expectations.
How comfortable are you multitasking across several software platforms during a live call?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $17.34 to $27.75 per hour, with the exact rate depending on experience, background, and location
Shift: Full-time, hours of operation Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., specific shift assignment not detailed in the posting
Benefits: Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, referenced through myassurantbenefits.com, specific details not listed in the posting
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is an excellent match for participants who have completed your P&C licensing pathway and already have some insurance customer service experience under their belt, since the pay range tops out well above many entry level insurance roles. The projected October 2026 start date gives a nice runway for participants who are still finishing their licensing coursework. Just make sure participants know upfront about the video interview requirement and the identity verification process before they apply.
Career Pathway: Remote Licensed Insurance Specialist → Senior Insurance Specialist → Team Lead or Claims Supervisor
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
